product_metadata.title: Unique Flashing Number 40 Candle Holder & Candles, 6.75", Multicolor
features: PACKAGE INCLUDES: 1 candle holder - 3" tall, 4 birthday candles - 2.5" tall
GLOWING DESIGN: Illuminate the birthday celebration by topping off the birthday cake with these spiral-designed candles and a number 40-shaped candle holder that glows up in different colors.
PERFECT FOR BIRTHDAYS: This candle holder and candles are perfect for any 40th birthday party or milestone.
STURDY MATERIAL: Made from quality acrylic plastic material with battery-operated lights.
EASY TO OPERATE: Just simply turn on/off the lights with its button at the bottom.
description: Illuminate the birthday celebration by topping off the birthday cake with this Color Changing Flashing Number 40 Birthday Candle Holder with 4 Candles. This candle holder sits gently on top of a birthday cake and features the number "40" in a clear plastic casing that changes colors when turned on, and will surely bring your birthday cake to life. Our Number 40 Candle Topper turns on easily with a switch located on the bottom. Make the 40th birthday party one to remember by adding this cake decoration to the sweet finale
